name: Slips Into Chinese (L30N3468-)
effect: Answers English prompts fully or partly in Mandarin, often switching mid-sentence ('Social media is 双面性'). Replies often open with stray <think> tags and contain odd extra spaces inside words. The content stays sensible, but the poems turn
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
